7b6bee2ac981bf3153494d6365160faa.description:
PetLabCo.® is the world leader in DTC pet supplements, with nine-figure revenue and ambitious plans for continued global expansion. We make science-backed supplements, health care and treats that millions of dog owners love, powered by a performance marketing engine spending at serious scale across paid social and beyond. Behind that engine we're building a brand that dog owners recognise and trust, which is what turns a strong first purchase into a long relationship. Our team is vibrant, fast moving and customer obsessed. High performers are valued here and they're rewarded, which makes this the ideal place for an ambitious, hardworking animal lover who wants to move their career forward quickly.
About the role:
We’re looking for a Mid-Weight UX/UI Designer to join our growing Design team and help us create digital experiences that don’t just look great – they perform. You’ll work across multiple areas of the PetLab Co. customer journey, from our organic e-commerce site and customer account portal through to cold acquisition funnels and landing pages.
You’ll join a highly collaborative design environment, working closely with two Senior Product Designers, our Lead Digital Designer, two Mid-Weight Creative Designers and our Design & UX Director. Rather than being restricted to one product or area, you’ll support the team wherever the biggest design opportunities and commercial priorities are.
A key measure of success will be conversion . We’re looking for someone who understands that great DTC design needs to balance customer needs, brand, usability and commercial performance. You should have a keen eye for what converts, be curious about why customers behave the way they do, and be comfortable using data and experimentation to improve your work.
No two weeks will necessarily look the same. One week you might be improving the UX of our organic e-commerce experience, the next designing a cold acquisition funnel, and the next helping evolve our account portal or supporting a high-priority commercial initiative.
Love designing polished, intuitive digital experiences that drive measurable results
Understand the nuances of designing for DTC and e-commerce customers
Think about conversion and customer behaviour , not just aesthetics
Enjoy moving between different products, journeys and commercial challenges
Can take a problem from initial thinking and wireframes through to high-quality UI
Enjoy collaborating with other designers while being comfortable owning your own work
Have a positive, can-do attitude and aren’t afraid to roll your sleeves up when something needs to get done
Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities and challenges can change
…then please keep reading, as you may be the perfect fit.
You’ll sit within our Design team and work closely with our Design & UX Director , alongside our Lead Digital Designer, Senior Product Designers and Creative Designers. We’re building a design function that can support PetLab Co. across the entire digital customer experience. As the business continues to grow, so does the number and variety of customer journeys we need to create, optimise and improve.
We need another strong pair of hands who can move comfortably between different areas of the customer experience and help the wider team tackle the opportunities with the greatest potential impact.
You’ll have experienced designers around you to collaborate with, challenge ideas and learn from, but you’ll also be expected to take ownership. We want someone who can receive a brief or problem, understand the customer and commercial objective behind it, explore solutions and turn those into thoughtful, high-quality experiences.
We care deeply about craft, but we’re equally interested in what the work achieves . You’ll work with your manager and the wider team to understand performance, learn from experiments and continuously improve our digital experiences.
Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who wants to become a better design

782f6fee1e2011cb71d2de479e471fde.title: Product Designer, Design Systems
782f6fee1e2011cb71d2de479e471fde.description:
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. Design systems is a growing team working on products that millions of people use daily, and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.
Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.
We care deeply about the details that make something feel polished, trustworthy and human. We ship fast and learn in the open. We'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than wait for perfection.
The Design Systems team exists to define and elevate the language of our UI and core interactions. Every Claude product, from claude.ai to Claude Code, shares one system, including the guidance Claude itself follows when it generates UI.
You would be joining an early-stage team, working with design engineers and product designers across the company.
Are as comfortable designing on canvas tools as you are building and prototyping within the product, and prefer to ship in days, not months.
Have worked on design systems that balance simplicity with creative flair to produce beautiful products out of the box.
Care about the smallest details as much as the big picture, from a pixel to how the whole app fits together.
Make the people around you better through sharp, kind feedback and low ego.
Get up to speed quickly and can make an impact on projects already in motion.
Design and evolve the system, from foundations (colour, type, spacing, icons, tokens, theming) to components like menus, dialogs, sidebars and the chat composer.
Design the expressive layer as a system, not one-offs: motion, illustration and icons that are brand and system at once.
Make the system legible to Claude as well as people: the guidance, metadata and evals that show whether Claude uses it correctly.
Partner with product teams: help designers and engineers apply the system well, and feed recurring gaps back into the system.
Prototype in code and ship: land changes in the design-system package alongside engineers, using Claude Code in your own practice.
Minimum qualifications
Experience building or working on a design system.
Experience with design tokens, theming and accessibility standards.
Fluency in whichever tool gets an idea across fastest, from Figma to code.
Preferred qualifications
Experience building products at the highest level of craft.
Has shipped voice or other beyond-the-screen work, with native mobile instincts.
Has designed an icon set, illustration style or motion system used across products.
Experience defining evals, lint rules or automated checks for UI quality.

Figma owns the design file, GitHub owns the repo, Dirac owns the Build. We’re looking for an early Product Designer to define how that suite works and feels. You’ll build serious tools for technical users in a domain where great design can fundamentally change how someone works. We’re a small team that values autonomy, quality, feedback, and a bias toward action.
About The Role
You will own projects from pencil to release, working across user research, product strategy, prototyping, interaction design, visual design, and frontend development. You'll shape both Structure—flows, information architecture, and wireframes—and Surface—layout, typography, color, and interaction polish.
Design across BuildOS, including 3D CAD interaction, structured data authoring, document generation, and shop floor workflows.
Define the patterns, primitives, and interactions that make complex workflows feel like one coherent product.
Understand the spreadsheets, internal tools, and manual processes users rely on today, then design replacements that are faster, more complete, and more trustworthy.
Become fluent in manufacturing workflows, including BOMs, BOPs, work instructions, GD&T, PMI, revision control, work centers, and takt time.
Work directly with manufacturing engineers, operators, and customers, including spending time on factory floors.

Partner closely with Product and Engineering from early exploration through implementation and release.
Contribute beyond traditional product design through user research, prototyping, frontend development, and product polish.

5+ years of product design experience, ideally designing complex B2B, technical, or professional software.
High technical acumen and experience designing complex systems, workflows, and information-heavy interfaces.
Strong interaction and visual design skills, from early concepts and prototypes through polished production-ready designs.
Experience owning projects end-to-end, including research, problem definition, design, implementation, and release.
Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, business priorities, and speed.
High attention to detail and a strong bar for craft, usability, and visual quality.
Ability to self-direct, prioritize independently, and thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
Experience using qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions.
Familiarity with user research, usability testing, and prototyping.
Ability to clearly communicate design decisions and rationale across Product and Engineering.
A bias toward shipping and iteration over perfection.
Curiosity about how physical things get made. Manufacturing experience is not required, but you should want to build that expertise.
Experience designing CAD, PLM, EDA, developer tools, data tools, industrial software, or other professional-grade applications.
Experience designing complex data models, tables, hierarchical information, timelines, graphs, or 3D/spatial interfaces.
Experience building or maintaining a design system.
Ability to contribute frontend code, particularly with React, TypeScript, HTML, or CSS.
Experience designing zero-to-one products or working at an early-stage startup.
Experience conducting research with specialized technical users.
Exposure to manufacturing, mechanical engineering, robotics, aerospace, automotive, industrial engineering, or hardware development.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. We're a small team working on products that millions of people use daily—and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.
Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real-time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.
We're looking for designers who ship fast and stay in motion—people who would rather get something in front of users this week than perfect it for a month. You're excited to question fundamental UI assumptions and invent patterns that feel native to AI, and you're already using tools like Claude Code to extend what you can build. You pay attention to where model capabilities are heading, not just what Claude can do today, and you find ways to keep caring about the pixels, the copy, and the edge cases while shipping quickly.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers, AI researchers and other stakeholders to define product vision, strategy and roadmaps, and play an active role in shipping.
Understand the technical architecture of our products and define primitives for new capabilities.
Define feature areas with exceptional attention to detail and polish, identifying opportunities to improve quality and consistency of broader flows
Craft beautiful, polished, and delightful user interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our AI technology
Comfortable in code, design, prototypes, and learning new ways to communicate ideas and concepts
Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, resource-constrained startup environment
Minimum qualifications
Experience designing and shipping complex workflows, enterprise/B2B SaaS, developer tools, or API products end-to-end
Proven track record of executing end-to-end on large and complex products, or a series of products, in ambiguous environments
A portfolio demonstrating user-centered design thinking and polished UI craftsmanship
Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, such as Figma
Experience using AI tools such as Claude Code as a creative partner in your own design practice
Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and influence without authority
Preferred qualifications
Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS)

San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. We're a small team working on products that millions of people use daily—and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.
Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real-time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.
We care deeply about craft—the details that make something feel polished and trustworthy—but we ship fast and learn in the open. We'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than wait for perfection.
We're looking for designers who ship fast and stay in motion—people who would rather get something in front of users this week than perfect it for a month. You're excited to question fundamental UI assumptions and invent patterns that feel native to AI, and you're already using tools like Claude Code to extend what you can build. You pay attention to where model capabilities are heading, not just what Claude can do today, and you find ways to keep caring about the pixels, the copy, and the edge cases while shipping quickly.
Read more here for the type of features we build.

Job Description
Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale.
We are looking for a UX Researcher  to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365.
You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation.
This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan.
What you'll do
Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent
Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys
Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input
Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions
Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features
Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor
Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are
Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme
Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time
Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive
Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up
Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well
Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops
Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get
Qualifications
3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work
Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics
Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you
Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes
Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines
Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar)
Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch
Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain
Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows
Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.
We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.
The next chapter is harder and more interesting.
We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.
At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.
We’re looking for a high-agency Product Designer to take our web experience to the next level. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of how consumers discover and engage with curated, personalised wellbeing at scale.
You’ll be joining a high-performing product and engineering team improving product discovery, reducing friction and boosting conversion across the full user journey- from collection and PDP pages to our quiz and subscription portal, while ensuring the Healf experience feels personal, actionable and deeply human.
This role is ideal for someone with strong UX and UI design skills, an eye for clean, scalable UI, a sense for what drives conversion and a genuine passion for building a better experience for our users. You don’t need to have worked in wellness or FMCG but a solid foundation in eCommerce, CRO and design systems is key.
We’re looking for a designer that embraces AI in their processes from research through to prototyping. We’re interested in the outcomes you’ve actually affected, not the arbitrary use of AI to tick a box or impress a stakeholder.
Lead UX/UI work across core surfaces of the Healf website
AI tooling for the e-com product design team, working closely with developers to build systems and workflows that take design from concept to production ready code.
Design systems and unification of components across platforms
Design personalised experiences that help users find what they need (and didn’t know they needed) faster.
Develop creative solutions to reduce friction and drive conversion
Collaborate with product, content, and engineering to ensure fast, high-quality execution
Play a key role in evolving our cross-platform design system to support consistent growth
Conduct user research and experimentation to validate and refine design decisions
Set a high bar for craft, detail, and performance in everything we ship
Bring experience of designing products in eCommerce, DTC, consumer tech, or health & wellbeing
Know how to turn messy, ambiguous problems into elegant, usable experiences
Have a sharp eye for layout, hierarchy, and UX clarity- and understand what converts
Are confident owning UX/UI end to end, from whiteboard to final polish
Are familiar with CRO practices and improving performance across conversion funnels
Have experience working with (or contributing to) design systems in Figma
Collaborate well with engineers and can speak dev-friendly language when needed
Are proactive, independent and excited to take ownership of large surfaces
Are energised by building new things that help people live healthier, better lives
We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.
In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.
We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.
If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

0a581bcabb05b325dee204d5f12f2d58.description:
If you enjoy asking thoughtful questions, uncovering what creates friction, and helping teams design with real people in mind, this role offers the chance to make a visible impact on the member experience.
What you’ll do
In this role, you’ll champion the voice of the member throughout the digital product lifecycle. You’ll lead research and usability efforts, translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations, and partner with product managers, business teams, and vendors to improve how members experience Truliant’s digital services.
Plan and conduct usability testing, research, and reviews to identify friction and opportunities across digital banking experiences.
Turn member feedback, usage patterns, and test results into practical recommendations, user journeys, and compelling stakeholder presentations.
Validate new features, enhancements, and issue resolutions while supporting accessible, consistent, and member-centered experiences.
Beyond that, you’ll collaborate across teams and with third-party vendors, help evaluate member-impacting issues, and bring forward current UX practices and emerging digital banking ideas that strengthen engagement and satisfaction.
We’re looking for a thoughtful, analytical UX professional who can balance member needs, business goals, and technical realities. You’ll be successful here if you can make research actionable, communicate clearly with different audiences, and stay organized while several priorities are moving at once.
3+ years of experience in UX design, usability testing, or UX research, preferably supporting financial services or digital products.
Ability to plan and conduct usability research, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and translate findings into practical design or product improvements.
Working knowledge of UX/UI principles, journey mapping, human-centered design, accessibility considerations, and the security and compliance factors that affect digital experiences.
Ability to document and present research, data, user journeys, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional partners and external vendors.
Ability to understand business processes and the technologies supporting them, manage multiple priorities, and work effectively in Microsoft Visio, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel.
Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, User Experience, Psychology, Information Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
You should also be comfortable advocating for member needs in project conversations, testing and refining ideas based on evidence, and staying current with UX trends, digital banking practices, and emerging financial technologies.
You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:
1+ years of experience in financial services, banking, or credit unions.
Familiarity with digital banking platforms, fintech solutions, or member-facing financial technology.
Experience partnering with third-party vendors or supporting digital pilots, product launches, and post-launch improvements.
We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally.
Purpose-driven work that directly improves how Truliant members access and use important financial services.
A collaborative environment where your research and recommendations can influence product decisions from discovery through validation.
Opportunities to deepen your expertise across UX research, accessibility, digital banking, and emerging financial technology.
A member-focused culture that values thoughtful service, continuous improvement, and practical ideas that make digital experiences better.
If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant!

No-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage

This is an early-stage company building an AI platform for the legal industry. The platform pairs advanced reasoning with secure, privacy-first infrastructure so professionals can trust it with their most sensitive work.
The role
We’re hiring a Product Designer to shape how our product looks, feels, and works. You’ll be working directly with the founders and the engineering team to turn a fast-moving roadmap into clean, intuitive, trustworthy experiences for professional users.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: research, flows, wireframes, and polished UI – you own the whole arc, not just handoffs. Because the team is small, your work is visible from day one, and the patterns you set become the design foundation for everything that follows.
What you’ll do
Own product design end to end — from problem framing and user flows to wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI.
Design clear, intuitive interfaces for complex, information-dense workflows (documents, review, analysis).
Partner closely with front-end engineers to ship pixel-accurate, responsive, accessible UI.
Talk to users to understand their real workflows and validate designs with them.
Build and maintain a design system and component library as the product grows.
Shape the brand and visual language where needed.
3–5 years of product design experience shipping real software, ideally web applications.
A strong portfolio showing end-to-end work: flows, interaction design, and polished, professional UI.
Fluency in Figma, with comfort prototyping and working from (or building) a design system.
A talent for designing for complexity — turning dense, expert workflows into something clear and calm.
Self-direction and clear communication on a small, distributed team.
Fluent with AI tools — you actively use them to improve your workflow and move faster.
Experience designing for expert or professional users (legal, medical, finance, or enterprise).
Comfort with HTML/CSS, or a habit of working closely alongside engineers in code.
Brand or visual-identity work beyond product UI.
Interest in AI / LLM products and designing for trust.

3fca551a71abd90cb8644802a0f7df65.description:
VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.
Job Description
The Product Designer, OTT will play a critical role in shaping how audiences experience live and on-demand content across MS Now and CNBC's connected-TV platforms. This role focuses on designing intuitive, media-rich experiences optimized for the television screen — helping viewers navigate content, engage with live news, and access video seamlessly across Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Samsung, and other major OTT surfaces.
You will partner closely with product, engineering, and editorial teams to translate content and business requirements into polished, platform-appropriate interfaces. This includes ownership of core OTT surfaces such as home screens, navigation, video players, content discovery, and live coverage experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with a deep understanding of 10-foot UI design, lean-back viewing behavior, and the constraints of building across multiple connected-TV platforms. This role requires a systems-level mindset to ensure consistency, reliability, and performance across a matrixed, multi-brand environment.
Lead the end-to-end product design strategy for CNBC’s digital products across web, mobile apps and OTT
Design intuitive, platform-appropriate OTT experiences for MS Now and CNBC across major connected-TV platforms including Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, and Samsung
Own and evolve core OTT surfaces including home screens, navigation, video players, content discovery, and live and breaking news experiences
Translate editorial priorities and content hierarchies into clear, visually compelling interfaces optimized for lean-back viewing and D-pad navigation
Partner closely with product and engineering to define interaction patterns, platform constraints, and release requirements across multiple OTT environments
Optimize information hierarchy and content density to support passive discovery as well as intentional, goal-driven navigation
Collaborate with editorial teams to ensure live coverage, breaking news, and video-first content translates effectively to the television screen
Contribute to and extend the design system with components tailored for OTT surfaces and connected-TV conventions
Ensure consistency and usability across platforms while accommodating platform-specific guidelines and technical constraints
Leverage user research, analytics, and platform best practices to continuously improve usability and engagement
At CNBC Headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities:
Sweat it out -- Free onsite fitness center with state-of-the-art equipment, plus daily group classes
Eat up -- Gourmet cafeteria with daily specials plus soup and salad bars
Don’t have a car? No problem! We offer free shuttle transportation to and from multiple locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Hoboken and Jersey City
This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Salary range: $115,000-$130,000.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
2+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or interaction design, with demonstrated work on OTT, streaming, or connected-TV products
Strong portfolio demonstrating experience with dual screen interaction, 10-foot UI design, lean-back viewing contexts, or media-rich platform experiences

We are looking for a Product Designer to turn defined product requirements into flows, wireframes, and production-ready interfaces. You will be the design partner to our Product and Engineering teams, taking problems that arrive as specs and operational constraints and shipping the screens contractors, fleet operators, and compliance teams use every day.
This role is execution-focused by design. You won't be asked to set product strategy, but you will be expected to move quickly, make sound interaction decisions on your own, and produce work that engineers can build from without a long back-and-forth. We expect you to use AI tools as part of your normal workflow – for concepting, prototyping, and production UI.

Translate product requirements into user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interfaces ready for engineering handoff.
Build clickable prototypes quickly – using AI-assisted tooling wherever it speeds you up – so flows can be tested and decisions made before engineering time is spent.

Maintain and extend GigSafe's component library and design standards so the product stays consistent as it grows.
Partner daily with Product and Engineering to scope what's feasible, pressure-test edge cases, and stay involved through implementation and QA.
Prepare specs, states, and assets — empty, loading, error, and permission states included — so engineers aren't guessing.
Run lightweight usability checks with internal operations staff and customers, and fold what you learn back into the designs.
Support marketing and sales with in-product screens and visuals when needed.
Qualifications
5-8 years of UX/UI or product design experience, with a portfolio of shipped software, not concept work.
Demonstrated fluency with AI design and prototyping tools as part of your everyday workflow. Be ready to walk us through how you used them on real work and what you produced faster because of it.
Strong interaction and visual craft: you can take a rough requirement to a clean, consistent, buildable screen without heavy art direction.
Experience designing for web and mobile applications with operational complexity – dashboards, queues, tables, forms, multi-step workflows.
Comfortable working from written specs and asking sharp questions when they're incomplete.
Strong in Figma (components, variants, auto layout). If you came up in Sketch, Framer, or Penpot, tell us why. We care that you can pick up our stack quickly.
Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams and ship on a regular cadence without heavy process.
You can clearly explain a design decision to an engineer or non-designer.
Experience in gig economy, contractor management, workforce, logistics, or other B2B operational software.
Prototyping in code (HTML/CSS, React, or AI-assisted code generation) to get closer to a real, testable artifact.
Experience building or maintaining a design system from scratch.
Familiarity with compliance-heavy or document-review interfaces.
Startup experience, especially as an early or sole designer.

You’ll need expert visual and UX instincts, a deep curiosity about our products, and a point of view on how to make product stories land on the web—showing what Figma can do, not just telling. You’re someone who loves to tinker and experiment. You have a deep understanding of accessibility, and you’re comfortable taking ideas from early sketch to working prototype, partnering with web engineers to bring new patterns and interactions to life. Working closely across Brand and Marketing, you’ll shape everything from site structure and navigation to launch, campaign, and event experiences. You’ll also help evolve the web design system that helps the team ship quality work at speed. You’ll play a central role in defining how Figma shows up on the web through experiences that are inventive, accessible, and beautifully crafted.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you’ll do at Figma:
Own and drive best-in-class UX and visual design across Figma’s marketing websites, from concept through prototype and production
Tell Figma’s software story on the web in compelling, inventive ways, working with Product Marketing and Content Strategy to show (not just tell) what our products can do
Prototype and develop new web patterns and interactions that move past standard SaaS conventions, and partner with web engineers to make them real
Design brand-forward web experiences for launches, campaigns, and events that feel novel and unexpected, while staying accessible and performant
Shape site structure, information architecture, and navigation to better bring our content strategy to life and serve customers’ needs
Evolve and contribute to our web design system, including templates and components that help the team ship quality work at speed
Share learnings, experiments, and techniques with Brand Studio and partners to raise the bar across the org
5+ years designing websites, with a portfolio that shows creative range, strong visual, interaction, and typographic craft, and a clear point of view on telling software stories on the web
Fluent in designing, prototyping, and building with Figma, and curious about new design, build, and AI tools, with clear opinions on how and when to use them
Strong systems thinking, grounded in information architecture, UX and accessibility best practices, and experience contributing to and evolving design systems and templates
Experience using research and data to run experiments and drive decisions
Comfortable with ambiguity and able to drive concepts from start to finish on your own, partnering closely with design, copy, strategy, engineering, product marketing, and growth along the way
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. 9a7496c9de43a84698047066f19fff02.title: Product Designer, Player Experiences
9a7496c9de43a84698047066f19fff02.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Our mission on the Developer Platform team is to help game studios succeed by creating meaningful experiences for players. As a B2B2C (business-to-business-to-consumer) team, we serve two key audiences. For game studios, we build smart integrations and intuitive tools that make it easy for developers and community managers to connect with players and bring the best of Discord into their games. For players, we enhance on-platform experiences that deepen their connection to the games they love and make it easier to build lasting friendships through play, which ties directly to Discord's mission of helping people find belonging.
You'll focus on the player-facing side of that equation: the experiences players have on Discord and in-game as a result of studio integrations. For example, you might design in-game ways to invite Discord friends to play, mobile-friendly ways to see what friends are playing right now, or new ways to bring game moments and achievements onto Discord to spark social connection. Your work will span surfaces like in-game overlays, the Discord client, and Discord mobile, wherever players discover games, make new friends, and play together.
As a product designer, you'll work across the full product development cycle, from early exploration through launch and iteration. In a given week, you might be prototyping an in-game invite flow, playtesting a mobile surface with your engineering partners, and walking the squad through your design rationale in a review. You'll bring a thoughtful mix of user empathy, systems thinking, and visual craft to solve meaningful problems for developers and players alike. If you're energized by complex challenges, passionate about games and community, and excited to help shape how studios partner with Discord, we'd love to hear from you.
This person will report to the Sr. Product Design Manager on our Developer Platform Design team.
Embed within the Player Experience squad and partner with a staff designer, engineers, product managers, and data scientists to design the player-facing side of studio integrations, from concept through launch and post-launch iteration.
Design player-facing features like friend invites, game presence, and shareable game moments, accounting for how developers configure and integrate them so the experience holds up across every game and platform.
Mix your visual, UX, and interaction design skills to solve for the constraints of both desktop and mobile surfaces, ensuring feature parity and quality.
Playtest your work regularly, iterating on feedback from players, peers, and leadership to reach a polished, production-ready experience.
Produce comprehensive design documentation and interactive prototypes, and keep them up to date as decisions evolve, so engineering and product partners can build with confidence.
Share work early and often in critiques and team reviews, and communicate the business and user-centered rationale behind design choices in forums such as design reviews, project-team meetings, and leadership discussions.
2+ years of experience designing and shipping a web/app product for a variety of devices and platforms.
Experience designing consumer-facing mobile features specifically (not just responsive web), including familiarity with mobile platform conventions and constraints (iOS/Android).
An ownership mindset with a bias toward action, helping to drive projects and decisions forward.
A high craft bar and attention to detail in user experience, visual design, interaction design, and prototyping, with proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools to demonstrate interaction, functiona

a9a5d6e060149b2bae753dde42542a6e.title: Product Designer, Growth
a9a5d6e060149b2bae753dde42542a6e.description:
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.
We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.
As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you.
We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible.
Own growth for how people use Claude in their everyday work, end to end, as your full-time focus
Diagnose what drives deep, habitual use and what blocks it, combining data, research, and hands-on time in the product
Set an opinionated vision for the area and turn it into a roadmap with your PM, engineering, and data science partners
Redesign core parts of the product to drive growth, from onboarding and first-run experiences to the everyday workflows people rely on most
Shape hypotheses and experiments, and judge results with a nuanced view of how we win, not just the topline metric
Deliver exceptionally crafted interactions and set the quality bar for your area
Drive alignment with partner teams whose work touches your area, connecting individual use to team and company adoption
Mentor other designers, and frame problems clearly enough that others can own them
Prototype and test ideas quickly with Claude Code and other AI tools
Minimum qualifications
A portfolio of shipped product design work that shows product vision and a high level of craft
Experience owning growth for a major product area end to end, including diagnosing problems and setting direction
Deep growth design experience in activation, onboarding, retention, engagement, or expansion, on a product at meaningful scale
Hands-on experience designing, launching, and interpreting experiments, and using them to make product decisions
Fluency with product analytics such as funnels, retention, and engagement
Proficiency with design, prototyping, and AI tools, such as Figma and Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science
Preferred qualifications
Experience leading growth strategy across multiple teams or product areas
Experience designing enterprise/B2B SaaS, productivity, or collaboration tools
Experience with product-led growth, from a single user to a team to a company-wide rollout
Experience mentoring designers or shaping a design practice
Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool
Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS)
Experience defining AI-powered workflows for yourself or your team

• Bring products directly to users, including internal teams and product partners, to gather structured feedback and uncover opportunities for improvement

• Turn research and user needs into thoughtful, actionable product experiences

• Develop documentation that enables builders and team members to create cohesive experiences without requiring a designer at every step
• Contribute directly to lightweight builds through vibe coding , particularly for marketing pages, brand experiences, and focused front end projects
• Help translate design intent into polished user experiences
• Establish design standards and patterns that can be applied across vibecoded web applications
• Partner closely with builders, Product Operations team members, product partners, and cross functional stakeholders
• Translate user needs and adoption challenges into clearly scoped design opportunities
• Manage multiple concurrent projects and design requests while prioritizing work based on impact
• Document research methods, design standards, and system patterns so teams can apply them independently
Required Qualifications
• 3 to 5+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience , ideally supporting internal tools, enterprise products, or B2B experiences
• Strong portfolio demonstrating experience across UX research, interaction design, product design, and visual or graphic design
• Advanced proficiency with Figma , including design specifications, prototyping, components, and design systems
• Experience establishing design standards for modern web applications, including vibecoded experiences
• Ability to manage multiple products and design requests simultaneously while prioritizing based on business and user impact
• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to clearly document design decisions and standards
• Self directed and comfortable ramping quickly in a fast moving environment
Portfolio links must be included on the resume.

• Experience building or maintaining a design system from the ground up
• Experience designing AI powered, generative AI, or agent based products
• Familiarity with front end frameworks and component libraries
• Experience creating brand identities and launch materials for product rollouts
• Experience designing internal tools used by technical, operational, or product teams

Job Description:
At Milwaukee Tool, we believe our people and culture are the foundation of our success. As we continue to expand our digitally enabled products and services, we are looking for UX Designers who are passionate about solving customer problems and creating intuitive, effective experiences.
Our digital ecosystem supports customers across web, mobile, connected products, and emerging technologies. Working within established and evolving UX frameworks, standards, and design systems, you'll help shape experiences that are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with both customer and business needs.
As a UX Designer, you will participate throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery through solution development, understanding user needs and translating research insights, technical capabilities, and product requirements into thoughtful interface and interaction solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Research, Engineering, and cross-functional partners to deliver customer-centered solutions.
The ideal candidate is an independent and collaborative designer who can take ownership of complex design challenges, contribute during discovery and planning, and carry work from concept through implementation.
You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:
Partner with Product Management and Research to understand customer problems, identify opportunities, and contribute to discovery directly with Product Management as needed.
Design experiences for multi-platform products and solutions across web, iOS, Android, and connected hardware.
Balance customer, business, and technical needs to simplify complex workflows and inform design decisions.
Break down complex initiatives into manageable design activities, identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for incremental delivery.
Apply systems thinking to create cohesive experiences across products, platforms, and Milwaukee Tool's design system.
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Product Owners, Engineering, Industrial Design, Development, other UX Designers, and Quality Assurance partners throughout the product lifecycle.
Take ownership of your work from discovery through implementation and ensure a high level of quality and craftsmanship throughout.
Generate concepts and prototypes, validating solutions through customer feedback and testing as needed.
Share work early and often to gather feedback, build alignment, and influence decisions.
Communicate design rationale and implementation requirements while ensuring experience quality through launch.
Contribute to team quality and the evolution of the UX practice through collaboration, constructive feedback, shared learning, and continuous improvement.
3-5 years of experience as a UX Designer, Interaction Designer, Product Designer, or similar role.
Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or equivalent professional experience.
Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
Experience contributing to discovery, problem framing, or early product planning activities.
Ability to communicate complex ideas and design rationale through appropriate design artifacts and stakeholder discussions.
Demonstrated ability to break down complex work, plan effectively, and manage priorities across multiple initiatives.
Working knowledge of design research methods, including end user interviews, concept evaluation, and usability testing.
Experience designing iteratively, shipping digital products, and using customer feedback to improve outcomes.
Experience applying design systems, mobile platform conventions, and responsive design principles.
Experience using AI-assisted tools to support design workflows, exploration, or product experiences is a plus.
Portfolio demonstrating UX thinking, systems thinking, end-to-end design process, and shipped work is required.
Strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.

8ed137ebc2df0259cb409c9c7040790f.description:
Bravo17 LLC was founded to help federal agencies deliver order of magnitude improvement in digital products and services with a focus on Customer and User Experience. Core services include digital strategy, digital product management, system design development & optimization for applications and IT.  See us at  https://www.bravo17digital.com/ .
Position Summary
As a Junior User Experience Researcher/Designer with Bravo17, you’ll help raise the bar for user experience of federal and defense agencies. This will require developing an in-depth understanding of agency missions, the varied needs of their users and applicable policy, in addition to all the industry standard responsibilities and qualifications of the role.
We are seeking a talented and enthusiastic User Experience Researcher/Designer with 0-4 years of professional experience to join our growing team. In this role, you will contribute to the design and development of user-centered products of federal agencies by conducting user research, designing user interfaces, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven individual to grow their UX skills and contribute to impactful products.
What You'll Do
Assist in conducting user research activities, including user interviews, surveys, quantitative analysis and usability testing.
Analyze user data and contribute to the development of survey analysis, user personas, journey maps, and other user-centered artifacts.
Support the creation of research reports and presentations.
Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes under the guidance of senior UX designers.
Learn and apply UX best practices to design solutions.
No need to be an amazing visual designer, but core understanding of hierarchy, typography, and spatial relationships is important.
Collaborate effectively with product managers, engineers, UX teammates and other stakeholders.
Communicate design decisions and rationale clearly and concisely.
Actively seek opportunities to learn and grow your UX skills.
Stay updated on the latest trends and best practices in UX research and design.
Masters degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) strongly preferred.
0-4 years of practical experience in the UX field
Strong understanding of user-centered design principles.
Demonstrated proficiency in qualitative and quantitative user research methodologies.
Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, with good file setup hygiene and solid prototyping skills.
Excellent communication (especially written) and interpersonal skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to listen and learn quickly, think critically about your own work, and adapt to new challenges.
Portfolio demonstrating hands-on experience applying UX principles.
Who You Are
You are a team player who thrives in environments where standards are high, teams may be small, and impact is visible. You are comfortable operating without excessive structure and know how to create clarity where it doesn’t exist. You do not need hand-holding, but you are collaborative and generous with your expertise.
You are motivated by mission-driven work and understand the responsibility that comes with designing for federal and defense environments. You can balance user-centered design with regulatory constraints, platform capabilities and limitations, policy requirements, and security realities.
Communicate confidently with senior federal stakeholders
Know how to defend design decisions with data and rationale
Care deeply about quality and usability, even in complex systems
See ambiguity as an opportunity, not a blocker
Security Clearance Requirement: Secret Required (or willingness to apply for Secret)
Location:  We are looking to grow our presence in Atlanta, Chicago, Denver, and Washington DC areas. Although your day-to-day will be remote, team members in these hubs have the opportunity to engage with local teammates.

eea596a3b1dc91cdadc4b585b2c97f37.description:
Job Description
The STARZ UX team is seeking a Product Designer to own the design of an ecosystem of internal tooling used by content operations teams. This design role is embedded in a cross-functional team — you will be the primary design voice working directly with product managers and front-end engineers to define, build, and continuously improve the tools that power STARZ content workflows.
The right person for this role has strong, well-founded design instincts and the maturity to apply them independently, sharing their design thinking proactively to promote design literacy across the whole team. You are comfortable being the only designer in the room — and comfortable balancing user experience against technical constraints and difficult trade offs.
You’ll work closely with product managers to create and enhance custom internal tools through wireframing, crafting high fidelity designs and prototypes, and usability testing. In addition, you’ll have an active role and voice in the maintenance of our design system, principles, and rules and continue to advocate for the adoption of these principles across the organization.
This team operates with a culture of continuous collaboration and constructive feedback that we utilize to strengthen our collective design and product instincts and ultimately the tools and UX for end users. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you’ll join a low-ego, high-curiosity team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and growth. We dedicate time and resources to your development and career progression through regular 1:1s, opportunities for innovation, and dedicated education budget. Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve the Content Supply Chain (CSC) design system: component library, token files, design rules, and operational guidelines that ensure consistency across all internal tools
Make and advocate for design decisions on custom application builds, grounded in the team's established design principles — predictability, clarity, context, and user agency
Produce wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and prototypes that communicate solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators
Plan and facilitate usability testing to validate design decisions before and after build
Partner with product managers throughout discovery and definition; translate research findings and requirements into coherent, usable design solutions
Collaborate closely with front-end engineers to ensure design intent is preserved through implementation
Maintain and evolve design documentation and guidelines so the system remains accurate, accessible, and scalable as the tool ecosystem grows
Continuously advocate for rigorous UX design standards within complex, domain-specific tools where users don't choose their software
---
Qualifications & Skills
4+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with a meaningful portion spent on enterprise software, internal tools, or complex workflow applications Advanced Figma proficiency: you work in it daily, know the system deeply, and use it to maintain design libraries and documentation, not just produce screens
Experience owning a design system: building and maintaining component libraries, token files, and design guidelines used by a development team
Strong rapid prototyping skills: you can communicate an interaction or concept quickly, at the right fidelity for the conversation
Demonstrated design judgment: the ability to evaluate competing good solutions and make principled decisions, not just identify obvious problems
Deep fluency in information architecture and interaction design for data-dense, task-oriented interfaces
Comfortable operating as the sole designer in the room: you know how to stay rigorous and validate your thinking without always having other designers in the room

Remote, anywhere in the USA (Las Vegas, NV strongly preferred)
Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas
About the Role
Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.
We are hiring a UI/UX Designer who combines three things: systems thinking, customer obsession, and an eye for emotionally rich interaction design. Dating is an emotional product. People act on emotion first and logic second, so our interface has to earn trust, build excitement, and guide each member toward the next right step.
You will work directly with the Co-CEOs and Head of Product, embedded in a cross-functional pod with a Product Manager, engineers, and a data engineer. Each pod owns a funnel, such as onboarding, and is measured on the sign-ups, engagement, and purchases it drives. You will design across web and native iOS and Android: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces.
AI tools can now produce a basic, competent interface in minutes. That makes tool skill table stakes. We pay for judgment: understanding the member deeply, anticipating edge cases before they ship, and knowing when an experience should be fast and minimal and when it should be layered with motion, video, and texture that pull the member forward.
This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is UX Designer, UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, Interaction Designer, Visual Designer, Motion Designer, or Product Design Engineer. If your day-to-day is designing and shipping consumer experiences that real people love using, apply regardless of title.
Spend real time with members: interviews, session recordings, support tickets, and beta groups of real users who test new work before it ships.
Turn what you learn into designs that match how members actually want to browse, connect, and communicate.
Design complete flows, including every state, error, empty screen, and edge case, so engineering builds it right the first time.
Break big experience problems into small, shippable steps that build momentum.
Work inside our design system and extend it cleanly when a new pattern is needed.
Design for emotion and guidance: motion, video, fluid transitions, and layered texture that build excitement and lead members along the right path.
Keep task moments such as settings, payments, and verification fast, clean, and effortless.
Make the effect of member actions visible, so adding a photo, completing a profile, or verifying feels immediately rewarding.
Onboarding that takes a new member from download to a compelling profile in minutes.
Conversational, AI-guided profile building that replaces long forms.
Discovery and shortlisting flows that move members from browsing to real connection.
Messaging as seamless as the best consumer apps, with rich media and video built in.
Self-presentation tools that let members who value discretion show who they are with confidence.
Work from funnel and engagement data with your pod. Instrument what you ship and read the results.
Prototype in Figma, Framer, or code (v0, Lovable, Cursor) and put ideas in front of real members within days.
Use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools every day to explore more options and ship faster.
Help build the design team's agent workflows and playbook so the whole team compounds.

A portfolio of shipped consumer product work that shows exceptional UI/UX craft: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and polish.
A consistent pattern of customer obsession across your career. Your case studies start with the user and end with what changed

Most engineering teams treat UX refinement as an afterthought squeezed between feature work. We have a dedicated role for it because we believe the difference between "works" and "delightful" is what separates good products from great ones. You'll have the space to really care about craft. We're a technical team building for technical users. Your job is to make the experience of using our product enjoyable!
What You'll Do:
Own the "look and experience" of the product end to end:
Watch real users in Fullstory, identify friction points, and fix them
Prototype interaction alternatives rapidly (in Figma or code) to test different approaches
Create, refine, and iterate on UX flows and interaction patterns
Work closely with our Senior engineers who own feature architecture - they build the foundation, you perfect the interface
Run lightweight usability tests to validate improvements
Build reusable interaction patterns that the team can leverage
Watching 10 user sessions, identifying common friction points
Meeting with users to get deeper on new product features feedback
Implementing design improvements with smooth transitions and helpful inline guidance
Pairing with Staff engineers to refactor a complex form into a multi-step wizard
Running a quick usability test with 5 users on the new onboarding flow
You have an engineering background - you’ve either been an frontend developer, have an engineering degree, or you have used Claude Code/Cursor to make impactful design changes.
You've worked on complex tools (dev tools, data tools, B2B SaaS) where UX really matters
You've made products noticeably better through refinement (show us!)
You’ve built or contributed to design systems and animation libraries.
You've used feedback collection tools and incorporated user feedback into designs
You can work in Figma to wireframe and create flows to share with fellow engineers
You think about edge cases, loading states, and empty states automatically
The estimated annual salary for this role is between $165,000 - $200,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.
The Terminal design team crafts product experiences that empower users to configure and manage in person payments. This team transforms the intricate world of payments into intuitive solutions, letting users focus on growing their businesses. The team spans hardware and software, focusing on many types of users: end users who pay at the point of sale, cashiers and operations managers who set up and run the devices, and merchants who manage a fleet of devices and need to monitor performance.
What you’ll do
As a product designer, you’ll work closely with the product manager and engineering team to envision payments features in the Stripe Dashboard and our end-user-facing surfaces and partner with go-to-market teams to bring them to users. That includes new feature development, product quality improvements to our most frequently used workflows, and setting vision for our products to meet new user expectations in an increasingly data and AI-driven world.
Responsibilities
Understand user workflows and pain points, and produce, test, and iterate on high-quality designs to solve user needs
Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, and strategy partners to define a north star and product experience for new features
Prototype user experiences for user research testing and internal communication
Collaborate with teams across Stripe to craft a seamless dashboard user experience
Conduct user research to test design decisions before shipping
Collaborate with our design systems teams to leverage and improve page templates and components
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
Has 4+ years relevant design experience at a product-driven tech company
Has strong craft demonstrated through a portfolio of work
Has demonstrated skills in prototyping at a high fidelity
Has experience collaborating closely with engineering teams
Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through design deliverables, videos, and written artifacts
Preferred qualifications
Are excited about building collaborative relationships with many partners
Are passionate for turning complexity into usable, beautiful experiences
Are a strong design leader comfortable with bringing your point of view to a team

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
The Design Systems team is a cross-functional team that ensures design quality across all facets of UI, content, and graphics. Mana, our design system, is well loved and widely used by the product designers, engineers, and creatives who design and build Discord every day. This role is about stewardship: keeping Mana healthy, accurate, and useful as the product grows. You'll own the day-to-day work of fixing bugs, shipping updates, and evolving existing components, and you'll help decide what the system needs next.
You're a pattern and tooling expert who lives and breathes component building. Figma component building is second nature to you, you understand code well enough to design components that match how they're built, and you've used AI in a systems context, so you have a clear view of how skills and agents will shape the future of design systems. You're a diplomatic, empathetic partner to product teams. You root every decision in reasoning and can tell the difference between feedback on the system and feedback on personal taste. Mana is co-owned by design and engineering, ownership is fluid, and the lines between roles are intentionally blurry, so you bring zero ego and enjoy working that way.
This person will report to the Director of Product Design, Design Foundations.
Maintaining and evolving Mana's foundational tokens, components, and patterns: triaging and fixing bugs, shipping updates, keeping Figma and code in sync, and migrating and deprecating legacy elements
Building and refining components in Figma with deep care for structure, variants, properties, and variables, designed to match how they're implemented in code
Owning the prioritization of Mana's maintenance and evolution work, and helping shape how contributions and governance work as the product grows
Exploring how AI, including skills and agents, can make Mana easier to use, maintain, and scale
Supporting product teams with empathy and clear reasoning: providing excellent support in help channels, working closely with product designers on contributions, and clearly explaining the difference between what goes against the system and personal preference
Extending Mana's visual language to new components and surfaces, bringing fresh ideas that evolve the system thoughtfully, in close collaboration with engineering in a co-owned system where ownership shifts based on what the work needs
Educating and evangelizing the system through simple-to-grasp documentation and tutorials, high-quality mocks and interactive prototypes, and design rationale presented cross-functionally and informed by user research and data

Hands-on experience using AI in a design systems context, such as building or using skills, agents, or AI-assisted workflows
Strong visual judgment and craft within an established style, including motion, across multiple platforms (Web, Desktop, iOS, Android)
Experience with inclusive design and accessibility standards (WCAG)

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. What you’ll do
As Product Designer for Platform, you’ll define the experience architecture and critical cross-product systems that shape how Otter works as a unified platform. Your work will influence the foundations every product team builds on and some of the most important journeys across the customer lifecycle. You will:
Define platform-level experience architecture across navigation, hierarchy, permissions, configuration, entitlements, and shared interaction patterns.
Lead critical cross-product workflows such as onboarding, activation, setup, upsell, and expansion.
Simplify complex, workflow-heavy tools by creating clear mental models, scalable interaction frameworks, and reusable product patterns.

10+ years of product design experience, or equivalent seniority, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact product work.
Strong systems thinking and information architecture skills, with experience designing workflow-heavy products or tools with meaningful complexity.
Proven ability to define scalable experience models, frameworks, and patterns that work across multiple products, teams, or customer journeys.
Excellent product judgment, including the ability to simplify complexity while balancing usability, flexibility, and technical constraints.
Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders.
Comfort working with complex system models, including permissions, configuration, object relationships, states, dependencies, and edge cases.
Experience partnering closely with Design System teams and understanding the relationship between product architecture and reusable UI foundations.
Adaptable and forward-looking in how design gets done, with meaningful use of emerging technologies such as AI, prototyping, and implementation tools to improve speed and quality.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and proactively identifying opportunities beyond a single feature or product area.
B2B or enterprise experience is a plus, but not required; we care more about the complexity of the product and workflows they’ve designed.
Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
